message: The other day, as the sky turned a bit gray, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter was asking if we had enough batteries for flashlights, while my son was busy sending memes about the impending storm. I couldn’t help but chuckle—who knew preparing for a storm could turn into such a lively debate? In the end, we all agreed that a little humor goes a long way in keeping spirits up. Just remember, a well-stocked pantry and a good laugh are both excellent preparations for any storm. 🌧️
